title: Era_Advance_Blocked enter-edge dedup (anti-chatter) is never pinned — block tests assert only boolean saw_*, never event counts
detail: The deduped enter-edge emission is a stated 6.2 behavior, but every block test uses a boolean saw_* (sla:206, legacy:255, crisis:310); the only count assertion is blocks==0 on the healthy path. An emit-every-tick regression, and reason-transition (Crisis→Legacy→Sla) re-emits, pass all tests.
recommended_fix: In the SLA/legacy block tests, count Era_Advance_Blocked events per blocked episode and assert exactly one per enter-edge; add a reason-transition case asserting one event per distinct reason.

title: Scripted Cmd_Era_Advance while the gate is BLOCKED is untested — only healthy scripted runs exist
evidence:
s.advance_gate_enabled = true
	gate_fixture(&s, cat)
	append(&s.action_log, Command{apply_tick = 100, kind = Cmd_Era_Advance{to_era = 3}})

	_, evs := gate_record_run(&s, 700, cat)  — gate_fixture is the healthy 100%-SLA network; the only other scripted test (line 461) runs with the gate disabled.
detail: The PR claims a scripted advance 'still works, gated the same way', but no test latches a scripted request into a blocked gate (Sla/Legacy/Crisis) and asserts it does NOT fire, then fires once conditions recover. The latch-held-while-blocked path is unexercised.
recommended_fix: Add a test scripting Cmd_Era_Advance at tick 100 with an SLA or legacy block active; assert era stays 2 while blocked, the latch survives, and the scripted era fires after the block clears.

title: E15 crisis test records fire_tick but never asserts the fire lands after Crisis_Resolved — the claimed ordering pin is absent
detail: fire_tick is assigned but never compared to the Crisis_Resolved tick; the asserted facts (saw_resolve, era==4, saw_crisis) would also hold if the fire preceded resolution. The comment's 'never mid-crisis' ordering is not actually pinned.
recommended_fix: Record resolve_tick alongside fire_tick and assert fire_tick > resolve_tick (and fire_tick != max(u64)).

title: Per-class SLA term never exercised with multiple active classes — all block-path tests run era 2 (roster {email} only)
evidence:
s.era = 2
	s.advance_gate_enabled = true  (test_advance_gate_sla_block) — and core/era_test.odin:48: "make_row(cat, 2, \"email_web\", \"Email & Web\", 2, {ei}, {res, rt, sb}, {na, std})" — era 2's active-class roster is email alone; era-3 (two-class) appears only in the crisis test, which asserts no per-class ratios.
detail: era_gate_sla_ok fails if ANY active class is under the bar and skips non-roster classes, but no test builds a two-active-class run where one class dips below 95% (partial failure) or where a non-active class has completions (the era_class_unlocked skip branch).
recommended_fix: Add an era-3 two-class test: email at 100%, streaming flooded below 95% — assert Era_Advance_Blocked{Sla} and no fire; optionally a non-active-class-with-completions neutrality case.
